The '''monarch''' of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pavia]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] sought to keep the planet neutral and discouraged the [[Heir to Pavia's throne|heir's]] interest in galactic politics, but was [[Death/Legends|assassinated]] by a galactic power in order to put the heir on the throne.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Diplomacy|Out With the Old}}</ref>
